{{Quote|Successors to Harrsk, Delvardus, and the others now held power within the Deep Core kingdoms, and while warlords such as Foga Brill and Moff Tethys lacked military muscle, they made up for it in base cruelty.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="NEC" />}}
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] '''Jmanuel Tethys''' was one of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] "[[replacement warlord]]s" that came to power after [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] executed the thirteen most powerful warlords and [[Imperial Reunification|unified their forces]]. Like [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]], Tethys lacked military muscle and compensated with cruelty.<ref name="NEC" />
